summary:
Space Mission Design Game

I developed an interactive space mission game using Scratch. The game allows players to experience the preparation needed for a space journey. A guide helps players choose an astronaut costume and select essential supplies before entering a spaceship and travelling to the Moon. Players must then face a meteorite challenge. If they forget important items, it affects the astronaut or the game.

My project addresses NASA’s Space Mission Design Game challenge by allowing players to understand how selecting the right equipment and planning ahead are important for a successful space mission.

The project is important because it turns space education into an enjoyable, interactive experience and helps players understand the importance of preparation, decision-making and problem-solving in space exploration.
details: My project, Space Mission Design Game, is an interactive educational game developed using Scratch. It allows players to experience preparing for a space mission by choosing an astronaut costume, selecting essential supplies, entering a spaceship and travelling to the Moon to face a meteorite challenge. If players forget important items, unexpected consequences occur, teaching them why proper preparation is essential. The game benefits young learners by making space science fun while developing decision-making, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills. Its intended impact is to increase awareness and curiosity about space exploration and the challenges astronauts face. I used Scratch’s visual block-based coding language, sprites, costumes, backgrounds and animations to develop the game on a computer. The creative aspect of my project is that it combines storytelling, interactive choices and game challenges to teach players about mission planning through experience rather than just reading information. Important factors considered include astronaut safety, essential supplies, preparation, decision-making and successful mission completion.
